newsitem.title: POLAND: BIG bids for Gdanski shares.
newsitem.headline: BIG bids for Gdanski shares.

text.p: Polish Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych (BIG) wants to increase its stake in Bank Gdanski SA by buying 6,260,240 shares or 31.94 percent offered by the state treasury, BIG said in a statement on Monday.
BIG and its subsidiaries currently hold a 31-percent stake in Gdanski. The state treasury has 7,322,583 or 37.34 percent of the shares, but said it wanted to retain about five percent.
BIG said it bid for the 6,260,240 shares in Gdanski, which the treasury offered in its December invitation for negotiations.
The Bank of New York as a depositary bank currently holds 19.5 percent of Gdanski's shares, represented by 19.5 percent of the bank's GDRs held by foreign investors.
Small investors on the Warsaw bourse hold the remaining shares.
